name: Stage 26: Vallmotorp to Knorranvägen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 26, Vallmotorp to Knorranvägen.
utilities: Stage 26 is an easy semi-urban connector rather than a wilderness stage: a short paved-road start from Vallmotorp, forest and old track to Häggsjön shelter, then road/cycleway and Lövåsen/Katrineholm service edge before Knorranvägen.

Häggsjön is the main on-stage facility cluster. Official text lists shelter, toilet and jetty/brygga; OSM and shelter sources strongly confirm the shelter/fireplace, while toilet/jetty condition should still be checked on arrival. Treat the jetty as lake access, not an official bathing site.

Lövåsen is the practical resupply strip near the route, with grocery, restaurants, fuel/shop and bus access. ICA Maxi, Willys, MatPiraten/Coop context and restaurants/cafes are nearby; toilets should be treated as customer/business-dependent rather than standalone public toilets. Katrineholm station/centrum is the stronger transit/service fallback via town/connector options.

Public transport is much better near Lövåsen/Laggarhult/Katrineholm than at Vallmotorp. Vallmotorp-area rural service may require prebooking/complementary traffic; verify with Sörmlandstrafiken for the actual date.
waterSources: No official potable spring or tap is listed on stage 26. Carry water from the start or refill at Lövåsen/Katrineholm services.
Häggsjön is lake water only. Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee water quality, and lake water should be boiled/filtered/treated if used.
Do not confuse the reliable stage-25 Mellan-Malmen water point with stage 26; once south of Vallmotorp, the stage has no listed trail water source.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official/Naturkartan distance is 8.5 km. OSM relation 3925356 is tagged 8.5 km and measures about 8.46 km; Naturkartan prose sometimes rounds to about 9 km and Äventyrligare is around 8.36 km. Use official 8.5 km as canonical.

Draw Stage 26 as one continuous Vallmotorp-Knorranvägen route. The OSM relation is topologically complete but raw member order starts mid-route and can create large jumps; sort by connectivity and reverse for Vallmotorp-to-Knorranvägen display if importing directly. Keep Katrineholmsetappen, Stage 27:1, Ramsjöhultsslingan and facility-access paths separate from the main line.

Official difficulty is easy, with mixed forest, old track/forest road, asphalt road and cycleway sections, shopping-area edge, and a final short forest path to Knorranvägen. Expect a town-edge/transport-stage feel: practical reports describe a 600 m to 1.5 km road start from Vallmotorp, forest/old road, about 1.5 km near busy väg 55/57, and several kilometres of asphalted pedestrian/cycleway.
Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass.

Fishing at Häggsjön is explicitly not allowed. Treat the jetty as rest/lake-access context rather than a monitored or official bathing place; a hiker report mentions a rough bathing ladder, but this is user-reported and own-risk.

Use only prepared fireplaces and check current Katrineholm/VSR/MSB fire-risk information before lighting anything. Länsstyrelsen/Katrineholm showed no formal fire ban during the 2026-04-27 pass, but current road/fire-risk services should still be checked on departure day. Shelters do not guarantee firewood or rubbish bins.
No designated tent site was verified on this stage. Shelter use is first-come, shared and non-bookable; tenting should follow ordinary low-impact allemansrätten away from homes and sensitive ground.

Current access caveat: Trafikverket/Katrineholm roadworks on väg 55 between Katrineholm and Valla started 2026-04-13 and are planned through week 26, 2026. Eastbound road closure and major bus reroutes run 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-04; after that, expect traffic control, possible later detours and bus impacts. The walking/cycle path was reported unaffected, but bus access should be checked live.

facilities.name: Vallmotorp stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start/board area. Parking is not exactly at the board; official text places it about 300 m north.

facilities.name: Vallmotorp parking
facilities.description: Official parking context about 300 m north of the Vallmotorp stage start. Check local signs and capacity.

facilities.name: Vallmotorp road-walk caution
facilities.description: Early paved/narrow-road walking context after Vallmotorp, reported around 600 m to 1.5 km depending on source/interpretation. Walk visibly, face traffic where needed and keep dogs close.

facilities.name: Häggsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest node about 2 km from Vallmotorp, independently matched by OSM/shelter sources. Free, shared, first-come and non-bookable. Older history mentions ant problems that led to the shelter being moved; check the site before settling in.

facilities.name: Häggsjön fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/bbq at the shelter cluster. Use only when current fire rules allow; no firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Häggsjön toilet
facilities.description: Official stage text lists a toilet at Häggsjön; not all map sources show a separate toilet node, so verify on arrival.

facilities.name: Häggsjön jetty and lake rest
facilities.description: Official jetty/brygga and lakeside rest context. A hiker report mentions a rough bathing ladder, but no official bathing-place claim was verified; fishing is not allowed at Häggsjön.

facilities.name: Häggsjön lake-water and fishing warning
facilities.description: No fishing is allowed at Häggsjön. Lake water is untreated and should be boiled/filtered if used.

facilities.name: Lenatorp road-transition caution
facilities.description: Forest/old-road transition toward the main-road crossing. Regroup before traffic, keep dogs close and follow current markings.

facilities.name: Sågmon bus/access context
facilities.description: Rural/city-edge bus access near the route. Service and roadwork impacts should be checked in Sörmlandstrafiken before relying on it.

facilities.name: Sågmon national-road crossing
facilities.description: Main-road crossing/traffic-exposure context around Sågmon/Lenatorp. Cross only at the marked route, expect roadwork traffic/noise during the 2026 väg-55 works, and do not improvise road crossings.

facilities.name: Temporary väg 55 bus warning
facilities.description: Roadwork bus caveat: 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-04, lines 481, 683 and 780 have changed routes due to väg 55 works. In the Katrineholm-Sköldinge direction, Sågmon and multiple väg 55 stops may not be served and delays up to 15-20 minutes were reported.

facilities.name: Lövåsen bus and shopping area
facilities.description: Practical mid/late-stage transit and resupply area near the route, with bus service and nearby shops/restaurants. Verify current departures.

facilities.name: Lövåsen roundabout and cycleway
facilities.description: Shared urban cycleway/roundabout/shopping-area environment. Watch for cyclists, driveways, delivery traffic and roadwork-related diversions.

facilities.name: ICA Maxi Katrineholm Lövåsen
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply near the route edge at Lövåsen. Opening hours vary; not a trail-operated facility.

facilities.name: Willys Katrineholm Lövåsen
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply option near the route edge at Lövåsen. Verify current opening hours.

facilities.name: MatPiraten / Lövåsen food context
facilities.description: Food/resupply context in the Lövåsen area close to the route. Verify current business/opening status.

facilities.name: Lövåsen St1 fuel/shop/customer toilet
facilities.description: Fuel/shop/service context around Jontorpsvägen/Lövåsen. St1 lists toilet service and 24/7 station hours, but access may depend on business/customer rules; no municipal public toilet was verified in the Lövåsen cluster.

facilities.name: Österleden underpass/cycleway
facilities.description: Cycleway underpass/road environment after Lövåsen. Watch sightlines, puddles, winter grit and cyclists.

facilities.name: Laggarhult bus context
facilities.description: Bus/access context near the southern urban section, west of the route. Verify line and departure times live.

facilities.name: Knorranvägen stage end
facilities.description: Stage end and stage-27 start context. Stage 27 text says the start area has space for about five cars; no mapped parking object was verified, so treat as small informal trailhead parking.

facilities.name: Katrineholm connector/service option
facilities.description: Katrineholm station and town services are reachable by town/connector options and are the strongest transit fallback. Station has paid card toilet/universal toilet with opening hours listed by Jernhusen; not on the core stage line.

facilities.name: Björnåsen / Bearhill near-stage lodging
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden lodging list places Björnåsen/Bearhill about 100 m from stage 26, with cottage/tent-place context. Pin is approximate and should be verified for navigation; book/verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Ekbacken lodging off-route
facilities.description: Off-route Katrineholm lodging context more than 2 km from stage 26/27 according to Sörmlandsleden lodging list. Verify route and availability.

facilities.name: Väg 55 access roadwork caveat
facilities.description: Roadwork on väg 55 Katrineholm-Valla started 2026-04-13 and is planned through week 26, 2026. Eastbound closure/major bus reroutes run 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-04; after that, expect traffic control and possible later detours. Walking/cycle path along väg 55 was reported unaffected.
